questions.answer: Payment is due at the time of the reservation and can be made with a credit card. You may cancel up to 10 days prior to your rental date and receive a full refund.
For Coeur d'Alene Lake rentals, we deliver to 208 S 3rd street. For Hayden Lake rentals we deliver to 2369 E Honeysuckle Ave.

questions.prompt: Can I trailer the jet skis?
questions.answer: Unfortunately, the trailers are not included in the booking, nor do we allow the jet skis to be trailered by customers. All watercraft are already on the water and ready for use.

There are multiple marinas around both Coeur d'Alene and Hayden Lake that sell gas if needed. Watercraft gauges are never 100% accurate and we highly recommend getting fuel before reaching a ¼ tank remaining. You are not required to fill up with gas before returning.
Unfortunately, wetsuits are not included with rentals.

questions.prompt: How old do I have to be to rent or operate?
questions.answer: You must be 18 years of age or older to rent a jet ski, and at least 16 years old to operate one.

There is no boater's licensing required in Idaho. We will walk through standard operating procedures with each driver prior to the rental. State law requires all jet ski operators to watch a safety video that will be provided to all customers, whereupon you will be given a "Renters Acknowledgement of Education" card that must remain on the jet ski at all times. We highly recommend that all customers familiarize themselves with Idaho water laws and responsibilities, found

questions.prompt: How many people do the jet skis seat?
questions.answer: The 2ups can seat two people, but we recommend only one person ride at a time. The 3ups can seat three people, but we recommend only two people ride at a time.

questions.prompt: What is the condition of the jet skis?
questions.answer: Our fleet is upgraded and replaced yearly, and are well stored and maintained during the off-season to ensure a high quality experience.
No! The booking payment covers all expenses.

questions.prompt: Where on the lakes are we allowed to go?
questions.answer: We allow our jet skis to be taken nearly anywhere on either lake. We ask all customers to practice safe and defensive driving behavior by obeying no-wake zones, as well as maintaining a safe distance from shorelines, shallow bays, and other water vehicles.

There is no cancellation fee if you cancel more than 10 days before your reservation date. If you cancel less than 10 days but more than 48 hours from your rental date then there is a 15% fee charged. There are no refunds given 48 hours or less from the rental date. If on the day you rent it is hazardous to be on the water (such as lightning or very high winds) then we will first try to move you to another day if possible, if another day will not work then a full refund will be given.
